column1: # Portable subset of the measured gfx1201 flagship modules (flagship-pack-gfx1201.tsv): every measured hip module that the published
# v0.4.4 kernel packs ship for BOTH gfx1100 and gfx1151 (pack index of hipfire-v0.4.4-linux-rocm-gfx{1100,1151}-x64). Each must be
# registered, with the measured symbol, for gfx1201, gfx1100 and gfx1151. gfx1201-only measured modules (VMM fp8 KV, rows/seg twins,
# *_gfx1201 attention/FA2) are excluded: their sources hard-#error or their launchers refuse off gfx1201.
# columns: module<TAB>symbol<TAB>routes (comma-separated flagship routes that loaded it on gfx1201)
